methods.label: Find the remaining interior angle
methods.explanation: The interior angles of a triangle sum to \(180^\circ\), so the third angle is \(180^\circ-50^\circ-60^\circ=70^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: This is the elementary application of the triangle angle sum to two known angles.
